en: The black and white image shows a garden or park with a circular fountain in the foreground. Behind the fountain, there is a low metal fence, and two children are sitting on a bench to the left. In the background, there is a striking round medieval stone tower with battlements, partially obscured by trees. Further in the background, two tall Gothic church spires rise above the rooftops and trees, indicating the presence of a significant religious building. The scene is lush with greenery and appears tranquil.
